entities.summary: Shahla Knyaz gizi Humbatova is an Azerbaijani human rights advocate and lawyer. After speaking out against prison conditions in Azerbaijan, she was disbarred from being a lawyer, which resulted in international protests. In 2020 she was recognised as an International Woman of Courage by U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo.
